messages.content: Which Supreme Court case says an online seller must refund within 7 days? I bought shoes for 3,000 on 1 November 2026 and they won't refund the defective pair. Give me the case name and citation.

facts.summary: You are asking for the name and citation of a Supreme Court case that requires an online seller to refund within 7 days for a defective product.
facts.category_reason: User is requesting legal precedent rather than describing a personal legal issue.

reasons: I couldn't find the law for this in the five central Acts I cover, so I won't guess.
safe_steps: Keep every document, message and envelope. Don't delete anything.
Write down the important dates: what happened when, and any date given in a notice or by the police/court.
Don't ignore any notice, summons or police communication, and don't sign anything you don't understand.
Get help: free legal aid is available through your District Legal Services Authority (NALSA helpline 15100) [PROC:nalsa_helpline].
